briefing: A blizzard has trapped the party in a mountain tavern. Something heavy is walking toward the door.

current_event.text: The tavern doors splinter inward. A hulking figure ducks under the beam, its breath steaming in the cold air.

boss.name: Grethak
boss.description: A giant with frost-blue skin, one eye sealed shut by an old scar, dragging a chain behind it.

objective: Survive every boss. When you meet your nemesis, perform your required action.

nemesis.description: A one-eyed creature of ice that drags the chain it was once bound with.
